content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of Board of Indian Medicine Latest Caste Certificates issued by Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study Certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class or Residency Certificate PH Certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kamareddy District Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download application forms and instructions from the official website of Kamareddy District. Submit filled-in application forms in person or through registered post to Room Number: 25, O/o: Collector and District Magistrate, Kamareddy District. Enclose self-attested copies of required certificates along with the application form. Make sure it reaches by 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date (31-10-2026) will be summarily rejected. District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kamareddy District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kamareddy District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 1 AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, 2 AYUSH Medical Officer, 1 Dietician, 1 Psychosocial Counselor, 1 Yoga Professional, 2 Multi Purpose Worker (MPW).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Kamareddy District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Official website of Kamareddy District) and send it to Room Number: 25, O/o: Collector and District Magistrate, Kamareddy District, by in person or through registered post, to reach by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/BC 5 years, Ex-Serviceman 3 years in addition to length of service in armed forces, Disabled Persons 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.60,000 for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, Rs.40,000 for AYUSH Medical Officer, Rs.20,000 for Dietician, Rs.500 per session & at least 200 visits in a year for Psychosocial Counselor, Rs.28,000 for Yoga Professional.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate, Master's degree, B.Sc, Diploma, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle for Multi Purpose Worker post. Rule of Reservation of Local candidates is applicable as per Presidential order.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list based on marks obtained in qualifying examination (90 marks for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacists, Dieticians, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional). Written test (90 marks) for Multi-Purpose-Worker. Age weightage (10 marks based on age as on 01.07.2026). Rule of reservation and Presidential Order.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Recruitment is on outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027 and thereafter services will be as per need and satisfactory performance.
